A '''protocol droid''' worked aboard the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] in the ship's cargo bay during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine's]] trip to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], it authorized the cargo brought by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]] containing [[Assassin probe/Legends|assassin probes]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was not aware what the box contained nor who placed it aboard, but allowed the cargo because it had a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] stamp. The droid claimed that stamp was always welcome aboard the ''Coronet''. Having said that, the droid unknowingly provided [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] with the knowledge that the box had been placed there by one of the [[Senator/Legends|senators]] on the ship. Later, when [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]] was revealed as the traitor, a [[Probe killer/Legends|Probe killer]] was released onto the table. It ran over the table and attempted to attack Duchess Satine, but was hit with a pan by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. This sent the probe killer onto the neck of the droid. The droid jerked around and collapsed, destroyed.
